# Shiv Shakti Industries

> Shiv Shakti Industries is a precision manufacturing business located in Makarpura GIDC, Vadodara, Gujarat, India. The website describes CNC turning, CNC milling, VMC machining, sheet metal work, assembly, and related engineering services.

## Public pages

- [Home](https://shivshaktiindustries.org/): Company overview and common CNC machining questions.
- [Services](https://shivshaktiindustries.org/services): Listed manufacturing services and guidance for preparing a component enquiry.
- [Products](https://shivshaktiindustries.org/products): Public component catalog. Product details reflect the current catalog and may change.
- [Capabilities](https://shivshaktiindustries.org/capabilities): Listed machining capabilities and material groups.
- [Quality](https://shivshaktiindustries.org/quality): Description of the site's stated inspection stages.
- [Industries](https://shivshaktiindustries.org/industries): Industries listed on the website.
- [About](https://shivshaktiindustries.org/about): Company overview.
- [Contact](https://shivshaktiindustries.org/contact): Contact details and quotation enquiries.
